scope: Additional provisional-ID agentic benchmark question portfolio; planning only. Preserve every OOD exclusion.
relationship_to_existing_plan: These question cards refine or split the existing 147 broad questions. They overlap the three existing detailed-design files and one another across benchmarks; do not sum them into an independent task count or a coverage forecast.

defaults.authoring_unit: One coherent question per recipe, single train split. Merge component diagnostics into a connected workflow when the same observations and estimand support it.
defaults.data: Observed, independently sourced biological data with native formats and sufficient biological replication. Freeze provenance and versioned source exclusions before implementation.
defaults.runtime: Plan an offline analysis boundary expected to fit 30 minutes; measured runtime remains an implementation check. Preserve realistic sample structure when bounding inputs.
defaults.rewards: Input-reading native reference scripts plus deterministic artifact checks; no LLM-as-a-judge. Free-form scientific interpretation is not complete coverage unless an explicit faithful executable contract is established.
defaults.parallel_authoring: Not started. Finish cross-benchmark question consolidation and record source-specific unresolved decisions first; then assign bounded packets sharing source/environment dependencies.
plan_limits: This card proposes an independent observed-data question; original biological observations, answers and source studies are excluded.
Exact named-entity substitutions, numerical thresholds and complete output schemas still require individual endpoint review where the inventory records only shared patterns or question stems.
A common question or workflow does not establish equivalent source protocols, independent studies or completed benchmark coverage.
